<Window x:Class="D2RBot.GUI.MainWindow"
        xmlns="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml/presentation"
        xmlns:x="http://schemas.microsoft.com/winfx/2006/xaml"
        Title="D2R Bot - MF Runner" Height="900" Width="1400"
        Background="#1E1E1E" Foreground="#FFFFFF"
        WindowStartupLocation="CenterScreen"
        ResizeMode="CanResizeWithGrip">
    <Grid>
        <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="300"/>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
            <ColumnDefinition Width="250"/>
        </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>

        <!-- Left Panel: Controls -->
        <StackPanel Grid.Column="0" Margin="10" Background="#2D2D2D" CornerRadius="5">
            <TextBlock Text="BOT CONTROL" FontSize="16" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="10,10,10,0" Foreground="#FFD700"/>
            
            <Button Content="START BOT" Margin="10" Padding="10,8" Background="#00AA00" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold" Click="StartBot_Click" Height="40"/>
            <Button Content="STOP BOT" Margin="10,0,10,10" Padding="10,8" Background="#AA0000" Foreground="White" FontWeight="Bold" Click="StopBot_Click" Height="40"/>
            
            <Separator Margin="10" Background="#444"/>
            
            <TextBlock Text="RUN SETTINGS" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="10,10,10,5" Foreground="#FFD700"/>
            
            <TextBlock Text="Selected Route:" Margin="10,5,10,0" FontSize="12"/>
            <ComboBox x:Name="RouteCombo" Margin="10,0,10,10" Height="30" VerticalContentAlignment="Center">
                <ComboBoxItem>Cow Level</ComboBoxItem>
                <ComboBoxItem>Pit</ComboBoxItem>
                <ComboBoxItem>Ancient Tunnels</ComboBoxItem>
                <ComboBoxItem>Chaos Sanctuary</ComboBoxItem>
            </ComboBox>

            <CheckBox Margin="10,10,10,5" Content="Auto Pick Loot" IsChecked="True" Foreground="White"/>
            <CheckBox Margin="10,0,10,5" Content="Tele Preload" IsChecked="True" Foreground="White"/>
            <CheckBox Margin="10,0,10,10" Content="Anti-Detection" IsChecked="True" Foreground="#00FF00"/>
            
            <Separator Margin="10" Background="#444"/>
            
            <TextBlock Text="STATISTICS" FontSize="14" FontWeight="Bold" Margin="10,10,10,5" Foreground="#FFD700"/>
            
            <Grid Margin="10">
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <StackPanel>
                    <TextBlock Text="Runs:" FontSize="11" Foreground="#AAAAAA"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="RunCount" Text="0" FontSize="18" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#00FF00"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Items:" FontSize="11" Foreground="#AAAAAA" Margin="0,10,0,0"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="ItemCount" Text="0" FontSize="18" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#00FF00"/>
                </StackPanel>
                <StackPanel Grid.Column="1">
                    <TextBlock Text="Uptime:" FontSize="11" Foreground="#AAAAAA"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="Uptime" Text="00:00:00" FontSize="18" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#00FF00"/>
                    <TextBlock Text="Avg Time:" FontSize="11" Foreground="#AAAAAA" Margin="0,10,0,0"/>
                    <TextBlock x:Name="AvgTime" Text="00:00" FontSize="18" FontWeight="Bold" Foreground="#00FF00"/>
                </StackPanel>
            </Grid>
        </StackPanel>

        <!-- Center Panel: Map/Minimap Visualization -->
        <Grid Grid.Column="1" Margin="10" Background="#2D2D2D" CornerRadius="5">
            <Canvas x:Name="MapCanvas" Background="#1A1A1A"/>
            <TextBlock Text="MAP VIEW - Waiting for connection..." HorizontalAlignment="Center" VerticalAlignment="Center" Foreground="#666666" FontSize="14"/>
        </Grid>

        <!-- Right Panel: Logs & Status -->
        <Grid Grid.Column="2" Margin="10" Background="#2D2D2D" CornerRadius="5">
            <Grid.RowDefinitions>
                <RowDefinition Height="*"/>
                <RowDefinition Height="Auto"/>
            </Grid.RowDefinitions>

            <ScrollViewer Grid.Row="0" VerticalScrollBarVisibility="Auto">
                <TextBlock x:Name="LogBox" TextWrapping="Wrap" Margin="10" Foreground="#AAAAAA" FontFamily="Courier New" FontSize="10"/>
            </ScrollViewer>

            <Grid Grid.Row="1" Margin="10,0,10,10">
                <Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="*"/>
                    <ColumnDefinition Width="Auto"/>
                </Grid.ColumnDefinitions>
                <TextBlock x:Name="Status" Text="●  OFFLINE" Foreground="#FF6666" FontWeight="Bold" VerticalAlignment="Center"/>
                <TextBlock Grid.Column="1" x:Name="BotVersion" Text="v1.0" Foreground="#666666" FontSize="10"/>
            </Grid>
        </Grid>
    </Grid>
</Window>

# Diablo 2: Resurrected Bot

A high-performance MF run automation bot for Diablo 2: Resurrected with full GUI and anti-detection features.

## Architecture

### Components

1. **D2RBot.GUI** - C# WPF Application
   - Professional game UI dashboard
   - Real-time statistics and logging
   - Route selection and configuration
   - Status monitoring and bot control

2. **D2RBot.Engine** - C++ DLL
   - Low-level memory reading/writing
   - Process injection and stealth allocation
   - D2R data structure parsing
   - Unallocated memory space binding (anti-detection)

## Features

- **Memory Binding**: Binds bot logic to unallocated memory spaces for maximum stealth
- **MF Run Automation**: Supports multiple routes (Cow Level, Pit, Ancient Tunnels, Chaos)
- **Real-time Monitoring**: Live player state, mob positions, loot tracking
- **Anti-Detection**: Random input delays, behavior randomization
- **Professional GUI**: Modern interface with statistics, logs, and visualization
- **x64 Optimized**: Full 64-bit support for D2R

## Build Requirements

### Windows
- Visual Studio 2022 (or later)
- .NET 8 SDK
- C++ Desktop Development workload

### Building

```bash
# Build solution
dotnet build D2RBot.sln -c Release

# Or via Visual Studio
# File > Open > D2RBot.sln
# Build > Build Solution (Release x64)
```

## Configuration

### Routes
- **Cow Level** - High density, easy pathing
- **Pit** - Mixed difficulty, better loot
- **Ancient Tunnels** - Immunes friendly, consistent drops
- **Chaos Sanctuary** - Highest tier, requires gearing

### Settings
- Auto Pickup: Automatically collect identified items
- Tele Preload: Preload next area while killing
- Anti-Detection: Enable random delays and behavior variation

## Memory Offsets

Key offsets for D2R (requires reverse engineering):
- Player state base offset
- Mob list pointer
- Inventory structure
- Area data cache

*Note: Offsets vary by D2R version. Update in MemoryReader.cpp as needed.*

## Safety & Compliance

⚠️ **Legal Notice**: Botting Diablo 2: Resurrected may violate Terms of Service. Use at your own risk.

- Unallocated memory allocation to avoid detection
- Input randomization and behavioral variation
- No packet manipulation (client-side only)
- Process monitoring compliance

## Future Enhancements

- [ ] Multi-route path optimization
- [ ] Advanced loot filtering system
- [ ] Character profile switching
- [ ] WebSocket API for remote monitoring
- [ ] Plugin system for custom routes
- [ ] Machine learning loot evaluation

## License

Proprietary - Internal use only

## Support

For issues or enhancements, contact the development team.

**C# WPF GUI** - Full professional interface with:
- Start/stop controls
- Route selection
- Real-time stats (runs, items, uptime)
- Map visualization canvas
- Live logging panel
- Status indicator

**C++ DLL Engine** - Core bot logic with:
- Process detection and attachment (finds D2R.exe)
- Memory reader for game data
- Process injector for stealth allocation to unallocated memory
- Modular structure ready for game-specific offsets

**Key anti-detection features**:
- Unallocated memory binding (`ProcessInjector.cpp`)
- Remote thread execution
- Memory-based operation (no file writes)

To build:
1. Open **D2RBot.sln** in Visual Studio 2022
2. Ensure you have the **C++ Desktop Development** workload
3. Build solution in Release/x64

The next step is reverse-engineering D2R memory offsets (player position, mob list, inventory) and implementing the pathfinding/automation logic for MF runs. You'll need to use tools like CheatEngine or IDA Pro to find current offsets for your D2R version.
